programme.desc: Caroline's naive, helpful nature comes out in full bloom when she starts catering to her new elderly neighbor, Miriam, but Annie thinks Caroline is being taken advantage of.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline discovers that only one newspaper in the country has not renewed her cartoon strip, she obsesses on the matter until finally convincing herself to face the editors in person.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline has difficulty confronting her neglectful building superintendent, Mr. Tedescu about her faulty plumbing, so she hires a mediator to pressure Mr. Tedescu into taking care of her request.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Richard is stunned when his former love Julia informs him that she is about to be married.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: In the ongoing charade of Caroline pretending that she and Richard are married.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: A remorseful Caroline panics when she realizes that several hours have passed since she poured her heart out to Richard on his answering machine -- and she hasn't heard a response from him.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline realizes that the constant aching in her neck could be related to the stress she feels over her unresolved feelings toward Richard, but she doesn't let it get in the way of helping Richard navigate through troubled waters with Julia.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline feigns having read a writer’s novel to impress him, but their first date is a disaster as Caroline’s charade crumbles. Meanwhile, Richard jumps to Julia’s rescue when her waitress job at Remo’s leaves her customers hungry for attention.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline discovers that she’s been receiving free cable, her honesty with the cable company gets her into deep trouble with her not-so-truthful neighbors.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Annie is visited by her old singing teacher, Miss McGowan, Caroline helps Annie pretend to still have her “Cats” role, an act that may have a surprise ending.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: It’s a game of messy politics when Caroline will not endorse a local councilman, who is inspired by her comic strip, while Del conjures up a promotional campaign.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Discreetly planning to ease Caroline’s homesick holiday blues, Richard (Malcolm Gets) goes to great lengths to get a gift for Caroline that inspires suspicion in Julia (Sofia Milos) and sleuthing from Caroline and Annie.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Used Car Salesman

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Informed by Annie (Amy Pietz) of Caroline’s (LeaThompson) unspoken love for him, Richard (Malcolm Gets) confronts Caroline, who tells him that it’s a thing of the past.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Love That Dare Not Speak Its Name

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is tapped as a celebrity guest star for a quiz show, her jitters prompt Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help her study, much to Julia’s (Sofia Milos) chagrin.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to convince an insecure Del(Eric Lutes) that he has the potential to be a great parent after Del is shocked to discover that he is the father of a 10-year old girl.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Julia (Sofia Milos) tells Caroline (Lea Thompson) that it’s not easy being on the outside of her close working relationship with Richard (Malcolm Gets), Caroline quickly, and mysteriously, learns what it’s like to walk a mile in Julia’s shoes.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: As Caroline (Lea Thompson) struggles with commitment issues over Trevor, Richard(Malcolm Gets) inadvertently causes a rift between Caroline and her new beau.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is insulted by a local cabbie, Adamo, she takes her case to higher powers at the travel commission. Meanwhile, Richard, frustrated by a “painter’s block,” becomes obsessed with computers when he joins a cyber cafe.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline’s (Lea Thompson)mother, Margaret Duffy (guest star Edie McClurg, “The Hogan Family”), visits Caroline for a mother-daughter People magazine shoot, tensions rise over unexpressed feelings.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Visit From The Mom

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) must hire a new cartoon colorist when Richard (Malcolm Gets) finally quits after he and Julia (Sofia Milos) move into their glamorous new home.
programme.sub-title: Caroline and the Marriage Counselor, Pt. 1

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: The fourth-season opener finds Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) savoring their first passionate kiss and preparing for romance.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Guys In The Bathroom

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Vengeful father-in-law Mr. Mazzone strips Richard (Malcolm Gets) of all his worldly possessions, forcing Richard to take temporary refuge in Caroline's (Lea Thompson) new office, where he runs afoul of Plum, the no-nonsense office manager.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After Caroline (Lea Thompson) inadvertently offends office manager Plum (guest star Nancy Lenehan, "Grace Under Fire"), she and Richard (Malcolm Gets) are banished to a damp, dark basement office.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After Annie (Amy Pietz) loses her boyfriend, her job and her agent, she impulsively accepts a date with her local drycleaner, Gil (guest star Ken Campbell),and spends an evening to remember.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) decide to go out on their first official "date" together on Halloween, but their romantic evening turns into fright night when Richard gets himself into a rooftop jam.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline stumbles across Richard's (Malcolm Gets) divorce papers in his desk drawer, but an office mishap sends her on a frantic paper chase to retrieve the documents after they are lost in the interoffice mail.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Tired of losing acting roles to other, more well-endowed women, Annie (Amy Pietz) surprises the gang on Thanksgiving Day by announcing that she plans to get breast implants.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Richard gets an offer that his empty bank account can't refuse: his Aunt Frieda promises to give him $5,000 as a Bar Mitzvah gift if he agrees to finally go through the ceremony.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Richard (Malcolm Gets) agrees to let Reg become a houseguest after the cartoonist has a fight with his girlfriend, Wanda.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Big Bad Bed

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A Christmas party at the garage is interrupted when Louie, the dispatcher teams up with Alex in a game of high-stakes poker against his cardshark brother Nick.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The taxi gang scrambles to come up with a scheme aimed at ending a one-sided romance when a determined, pretty cabbie sets her cap for Tony and joins the Sunshine Cab Co. to be near him.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex feels sympathy for a fare who’s a real loser with the women and arranges a date for the man with Elaine, who later discovers that her klutzy companion for the evening is a U.S. Congressman.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby’s career dreams come true when he lands a role in a soap opera, prompting him to throw his torn-up cabbie’s license at Louie, but the dispatcher vows to take revenge if Bobby ever comes crawling back.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: After an operation, Louie, the sharp-tongued dispatcher, panics when he has to keep a promise that he made to God during surgery to turn over a new leaf.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas’ youthful and attractive mother makes her first visit to America, and after she and Alex meet and have an evening love affair, Latka assumes that he will soon be getting a new daddy.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Alex’s ear is nearly shot off in a holdup attempt in his cab, he stuns his fellow cabbies by quitting and exchanging his driving clothes for a waiter’s tuxedo at a snobbish French restaurant.
programme.sub-title: Alex Tastes Death & Finds A Nice Restaurant

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies fall victim to a Hollywood-style roller coaster ride when a production company visits to do a film on taxi drivers. Life at the Sunshine Cab Company turns into a continual champagne and buffet festivity.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas frantically works to save the cracked-up Cab 804 as the cabbies fondly recall times in the legendary auto when Alex delivered a baby, Louie beat a rich brat out of a wad of money, and Elaine met the perfect man.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies are in for a comedy surprise when the small town kid Bobby befriends, Steve, lands a big role as Romeo the first day he arrives in the Big Apple.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex tells Elaine that her hectic schedule of being a mother, a cabbie and a museum employee is driving her crazy and that she should see a psychiatrist. Elaine decides that a quicker cure would be to spend the night with Alex.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex
programme.sub-title: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie makes a horrible first impression on girlfriend Zena’s parents on Taxi. Louie’s romance with girlfriend Zena takes an outrageous twist when she brings him home to meet her parents.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies try to make Tony a family man when they convince him to adopt the adorably precocious eight-year-old boy named Brian whom he befriended.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby faces a humorous predicament when it becomes obvious that one of the biggest talent managers in New York is representing him because of his prowess as a lover, and not for his ability as an actor.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a protest against unsafe equipment, the cabbies go on strike, and Louie offers an unusual solution to the problem to shop steward Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a hilarious caper, Louie and the cabbies pool all their cash to buy a painting at an auction, planning to cash in big when the artist dies—but when the bidding gets too heavy, the gang turns a dignified auction into a frolicking free-for-all.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie, the dispatcher, becomes a lovesick pup after his girlfriend finds another guy. He will stop at nothing to get her back, including recruiting Alex for his hilarious scheme—and the riotous shenanigans at the Sunshine Cab Co. never stop.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a riotous family reunion when Jim returns home to face his millionaire dad for the first time since he dropped out of society in the ‘60s, and Alex has his hands full with Jim’s voluptuous, overly amorous sister,

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The Taxi gang falls prey to hilarious fear for homeless Elaine’s romantic well-being when chivalrous Bobby allows her to live in his apartment while he is gone. Unexpectedly, he returns before she has found other quarters

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Hilarious sparks fly when Tony tries to fix up his divorced sister with Alex. Instead, she ends up falling for Reverend Jim and Tony goes outrageously overboard trying to break up the affair.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie the dispatcher has the dubious honor of being selected by his employer’s revenge-seeking wife to be her clandestine lover, and comedic panic grips the love lair when the boss shows up unexpectedly.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Wild and crazy theatrics erupt when Tony decides to become an actor and Bobby, as his skeptical agent, is aghast when Tony lands a role because he is the right type.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby’s vicious letter to a hated critic is salvaged from the wastebasket and sent to the newspaper by a gleeful Louie, setting the stage for a wild and comical night when the critic, and the cabbies, decide to take in Bobby’s one-man play.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Latka Gravas is rejected by a young beauty, he sets out on an uproarious crash course to learn to be a swinging American Bachelor, a turnabout that works fantastically with the girls but turns off all of his friends at the garage.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Jim turns into a soothsayer when he warns of a bizarre catastrophe to befall Alex that also involves an affair with a beautiful blonde.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The taxi gang hits the bricks in a hilarious hunt for new jobs when the Sunshine Cab. Co. goes out of business, with the promise that they will meet at Mario’s in one month to review their experiences.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore's Hottest Hookups
programme.desc: Vinny, Mike, Deena och Pauly listar de 15 hetaste 'Jersey Shore'-raggen, från Seaside till Miami, till Italien och hem igen.
programme.sub-title: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore's Hottest Hookups

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore's Biggest Blow-ups
programme.desc: Jenni, Ronnie, Vinny, Pauly och Mike listar de 14 största grälen i 'Jersey Shore', och återupplever det bästa av skitsnacket, smällarna, och bråken.
programme.sub-title: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore's Biggest Blow-ups

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Most Jersiest Moments
programme.desc: Mike, Pauly, Ronnie och Vinny ser tillbaka på några av de 'jerseyaktigaste' ögonblicken av deras semester i Miami - spiralerna, grillningarna, spratten, de äckligaste toaletterna och fem nya, aldrig tidigare visade scener.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: It's Complicated
programme.desc: Gänget drar till Las Vegas på ny familjesemester för att träffa Ronnies älskling. Men när Ronnies relationsdramatik sprids i sociala medier vet ingen vad de ska förvänta sig av honom.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Oh, Canada
programme.desc: Vinny och Pauly drar till Kanada, Jwoww konfronterar kompisarna, och sanningen bakom Ronnies förhållande börjar komma fram.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Truth About Ronnie
programme.desc: Kompisarna samlas kring Ron när sanningen om hans förhållande kommer fram, de går på kasino för att vinna stort, och Jen kommer tillbaka till sviten för en konfrontation.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Heartbreak Hotel
programme.desc: Vinny saknar sin älskling, gänget får en specialleverans från Staten Island, och Ronnie försöker plocka upp spillrorna efter en otrevlig incident med sin tjej.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Frenemies
programme.desc: Vänskap sätts på prov när Jenni ger Angelina en Jwoww-behandling, och Snooki hamnar i kläm och får agera domare.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Designation
programme.desc: Jenni tar farväl av Las Vegas och en festkväll leder till att Pauly fattar några tveksamma beslut.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Four Guidos and a Baby
programme.desc: Medan Nicole och Jenni försöker reparera sin vänskap tar Vinny och Pauly sin till nästa nivå. Och grabbarna avslutar sin Vegas-resa med guidos dröm.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Back to Seaside
programme.desc: Gänget lämnar Vegas bakom sig och minns 2009 med en resa till Seaside där allt började.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Vinny and Angelina: A Love Story
programme.desc: I Seaside blir det stökigt mellan Vinny och Angelina, men gänget har en trevlig kväll i sitt gamla hem.
programme.sub-title: Vinny and Angelina: A Love Story

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: What a Drag
programme.desc: Deena får veta könet på sin köttbulle, Ronnie överraskar med ett besök, och det blir intressant när alla tar med sina respektive till Atlantic City för att se DJ Pauly D uppträda.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation
programme.desc: Jens ankomst får gänget att vara på sin vakt när de försöker fira Paulys födelsedag i Atlantic City. Och Staten Island-historien tar en märklig vändning.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Where's the Beach?
programme.desc: Guidosarna har siktet inställt på en episk semesterresa till innan sommaren är över. Angelina har siktat in sig på Vinny och Snooki är redo att festa som om det vore 2009.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Staten Island Smackdown
programme.desc: Snooki ballar ur, Mike inspirerar och Angelinas och Vinnys grälsjuka relation når en punkt utan återvändo.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Jewish Barbie
programme.desc: Angelina och Vinny försöker komma överens. Deena kanske inte bara är köttbulle-gravid och Ronnie är med om en déjà vu-upplevelse när han badar bubbelbad med Angelinas vän.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Pork Roll or Taylor Ham?
programme.desc: Guidosarna saknar sin köttbulle Deena, så de bestämmer sig för att kidnappa henne. Och vad händer när Ronnie bjuder in Jewish Barbie att sova över i hans rum?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Wallopin' in Manalapan
programme.desc: Hämnden är ljuv när gänget ger igen på dumskallen som besvärar dem i baren.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Ronnie Magro's Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen tar Deena och kompisarna kampen mot cancer, gänget diskuterar meningen med livet, och efter ett mystiskt samtal från Jen får Ronnie ännu mer drama i livet.
programme.sub-title: Ronnie Magro's Series of Unfortunate Events

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The United States vs. The Situation Part 1
programme.desc: Gänget samlas för att stötta sin broder Mike, som ska få sin dom i skattebrottsmålet. Jwowws äktenskap knakar i fogarna, men hon snackar hellre om Angelinas förhållande än sitt eget.
programme.sub-title: The United States vs. The Situation Part 1

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Mary undergoes surgery after getting hit by a car and Annie prays for strength to forgive her father.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Don't Take My Love Away
programme.desc: At the church, Mary and Lucy get into a brawl right before the ceremony. It seems to clear the air and the slightly disheveled girls reappear with big smiles as the wedding march begins.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: See You in September
programme.desc: Annie and Eric can’t wait for the kids to go back to school, but they’re no sooner out the door than they’re home again...and in trouble.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: I Love You
programme.desc: When Matt catches the younger kids snooping, he sets a trap. But he catches Dad instead.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Who Knew?
programme.desc: Dad freaks out when he finds a joint in the house, and his trust for Matt may be lost.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Says Who?
programme.desc: Simon’s experiment with mind control backfires when Matt turns the tables and convinces him that he’s shrinking.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
programme.desc: The Camden house feels like Heartbreak Hotel when Wilson and Mary split up and Matt gets a “Dear John” letter from Heather.
programme.sub-title: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Lucy innocently courts trouble by prancing around the mall in a short skirt and high heels while Eric helps a not-so-innocent girl in a gang.
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Do Something
programme.desc: Mom’s muffins are so delicious she decides to go into business…and quickly burns out.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: I Hate You
programme.desc: The girls learn that words can really hurt people, and Simon befriends a Holocaust survivor.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Truth or Dare
programme.desc: Mary loses her cool when she finds out her brother paid his friend to go out with her.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Lead, Follow or Get Out of the Way
programme.desc: Mary wants to quit the basketball team when a new girl outperforms her.
programme.sub-title: Lead, Follow or Get Out of the Way

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Rush to Judgment
programme.desc: Mary’s hurt and confused when her coach’s interest in her moves beyond the basketball court.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Stuck in the Middle with You
programme.desc: Two boys are fighting for Lucy’s affections, while Annie and Eric are fighting in a marriage-counseling group.
programme.sub-title: Stuck in the Middle with You

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Red Tape
programme.desc: A mysterious personal ad in the school paper gets Matt more calls than he can handle.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Homecoming
programme.desc: The only thing keeping Mary from getting back on the court after her knee surgery is fear.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: It Takes a Village
programme.desc: Simon attends his first make-out party and learns more about girls than how they kiss.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Nothing Endures But Change
programme.desc: Lucy’s friend is killed in a tragic car accident, and Lucy feels that she’s to blame.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: My Kinda Guy
programme.desc: When the Camdens host a French foreign exchange student, everyone seems to be getting into trouble!

programme.title: The Young Master SV
programme.desc: Efter att Dragon blivit bedragen av sin egen bror, Tiger, står de två som representanter för rivaliserande skolor i den årliga lejondanstävlingen. Trots att Tiger vinner, tvingas han i exil av vanäran att ha förrått de sina.

programme.title: Knockabout
programme.desc: Två bröder och småskurkar, Yipao och Taipao, övertalar en kampsportsexpert att ta emot dem som elever, helt ovetande om hans smutsiga förflutna. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Fist of Fury SV
programme.desc: När Chen Zhen återvänder till sin gamla kampsportsskola möts han av den tragiska nyheten att hans mästare har dött. Snart upptäcker han att det finns mystiska omständigheter kring mästarens död, och han bestämmer sig för att på egen hand söka hämnd.

programme.title: Wheels on Meals SV
programme.desc: Thomas och David låter livet ha sin gilla gång, och kör sin foodtruck längs Barcelonas gator. Men vardagen avbryts plötsligt, när de efter ett möte med ett MC-gäng träffar en vacker ficktjuv, Sylvia, som söker skydd från gänget.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello, Rafael, Michelangelo och Leonardo är muterade gröna ninja-sköldpaddor som älskar pizza och lever under New York. Därifrån tar de upp kampen mot den ondskefulla brottslingen Shredder och hans armé av svartklädda krigare.

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem vänner som just kommit ut ur fängelset försöker hålla sig fria från brott, men hamnar oavsiktligt i ett triadkrig. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III SV
programme.desc: Det hela börjar med att en magisk spira transporterar deras goda vän April genom tid och rum, ända till samurajernas Japan. Leonardo och gänget ger sig genast av efter henne, och måste nu besegra den elake Lord Naringa för att rädda den inspärrade April.

programme.title: Spiritual Kung Fu SV
programme.desc: Yi-Lang är klassens clown i shaolintemplet där han studerar kampsport. När en mystisk bok blir stulen från templets bibliotek beskylls Yi-Lang för slarv och tillsammans med några andra munkar bestraffas han för sin ouppmärksamhet.

programme.title: My Lucky Stars SV
programme.desc: Hongkongpolisen Muscle åker till Japan i jakt på en korrupt kollega. Men då yakuzan redan har hans uppgifter kan han inte göra jobbet på egen hand. Efter velande kallar de in Muscles barndomsvänner för att hjälpa till.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Gathering Storm
programme.desc: The activities of nations after World War I that lead to World War II.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Lightning War
programme.desc: Country after European country falls before the unstoppable German blitzkrieg.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Hitlers Dödspatruller
programme.desc: När Nazityskland invaderade Polen 1939 och Sovjetunionen 1941 följde särskilda insatsgrupper (Einsatzgruppen) i den tyska arméns fotspår.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Britain at Bay
programme.desc: Germany makes critical errors during the bombing of Britain.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: The contestants meet journalist Gordon Smart and participate in a press challenge where they write a 60-second skit regarding their opinions of the other contestants, which they later present in front of the camera.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: Letitia, Lisa, and Roxanne receive a second set of makeovers. The contestants meet with Elle at Hyde Park, where they learn that the remaining five contestants will be traveling to Canada for the remainder of the competition.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The remaining five contestants fly to Toronto, where they take on the CN Tower's EdgeWalk before moving into their home at the SoHo Metropolitan Hotel.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: Star of The Hills and America's Next Top Model judge Kelly Cutrone gives the contenders a grilling in Toronto ahead of next week's final.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: Dannii Minogue joins host Elle Macpherson and Tyson Beckford as 28 hopefuls begin their battle for a modelling contract with a leading agency. The girls pull out all the stops but only half of them will survive the cull.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The contestants head to the National Wedding Show at Birmingham's NEC to be coached in the art of the catwalk by model Jade Parfitt.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: It's time for the contestants to receive their makeovers and host Elle Macpherson embraces the challenge by opting for a new look herself. After their transformations, the girls pose like professional gymnasts with Olympian Louis Smith.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2405
programme.desc: Johnny bor i Sandnes med sin flickvän Savina. Han har haft dålig kontroll över sin ekonomi i hela sitt liv, och nu skickar han hela sin lön till Savina varje månad så att hon kan förvalta hans pengar på ett klokt sätt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2406
programme.desc: Iselin bor i Vear och har nyligen genomgått en stor omvälvning. Även om Iselin nu är skild är hon fortfarande ekonomiskt gift - hon och hennes före detta man delar på stora konsumtionslån med skyhöga räntor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2407
programme.desc: Michael bor i Skien och arbetar som elektriker. När han var 18 år gammal tog han sitt första lån, och i stället för att stanna där fortsatte han att spendera pengar han inte hade.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tagit stora lån för att etablera sig med familjen men har tappat kontrollen och får en otrevlig överraskning när experterna anländer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Madeleine älskar inredning och hennes garderob är full av nyinköpta kläder. När Madeleine vill ha något nytt så köper hon det. Hon lever över sina tillgångar och de dyra lånen hopar sig.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Roy Erik köper och säljer klockor varannan vecka och experterna har aldrig sett ett sådant slöseri. Han köper på impuls och säljer med förlust. Med sin höga skuld kommer han aldrig att kunna köpa ett eget hus.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Helene har en bra inkomst, men i stället för att lägga undan pengar shoppar hon. Hon lägger 13.000 norska kronor i månaden bara på nätshopping och drömmen om att köpa ett eget hus känns avlägsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2401
programme.desc: Cecilie är känd från "The Tinder Swindler". 2018 träffade hon Simon Leviev på Tinder och blev lurad på miljontals dollar - så nu har hon en skuld som hon inte har spenderat ett enda öre på.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2402
programme.desc: Julie och Joacim från Tønsberg kämpar med impulsköp på kredit och har tappat kontrollen över sin ekonomi. De drunknar i skyhöga konsumtionslån och inkassokrav som sätter stopp för en livslång dröm.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle upptäcker skadlig information om Alexis äktenskap med Cecil Colby. Leslie följer Sean till hans fars grav och får reda på hans sanna identitet som Joseph Aynders son.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Tvingad av Adam och Fallons röst går Steven motvilligt med på att godkänna Vitron-oljeaffären, samtidigt som Seans vansinniga plan att hämnas sin fars död börjar utvecklas.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Uppmuntrad av sitt folkliga stöd efter skjutningen bestämmer sig Alexis för att stanna kvar i tävlingen. Sean påskyndar sin plan att använda Vitron-oljeaffären för att krossa Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sean är trött på Leslies hot om att avslöja sin sanna identitet och planterar en giftig orm i hennes rum som en varning för vem hon har att göra med.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Karen skyndas till sjukhuset när hon börjar föda. Efter att Sean hotar Leslie anförtror hon Dex Seans sanna identitet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis varnar Blake för Seans sanna identitet. Blake och Dex, som är oroliga för sin familjs säkerhet, åker till Natumbre för att avslöja Seans mystiska plan med Vitron-oljeaffären.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter explosionen i Natumbre anklagas Blake för att handla med illegala vapen. Alexis avslöjar bevis för att Sean betalade Jesse för att återvända till Denver så att han kunde övertala Karen att behålla Adams barn.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dana försöker desperat övertyga Adam om hur mycket hon vill ha deras son. Hon föreslår att om de var ett kärleksfullt par igen skulle domaren döma till deras fördel.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam befrias från misstankar om kidnappningen av sin son när Leslie ringer honom och berättar att Sean har tagit barnet och håller henne fången.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter Seans död tröstas Alexis av Dex, och de två förnyar sin passionerade kärlek till varandra.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo och Jeff är lättade när de upptäcker att kroppen som hittades flytande i sjön inte är Krystle. Blakes rädsla ökar när Krystles bil hittas och mannen som arresterats för att ha stulit den är en dömd mördare.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake njuter av sin tid med Krystle i Dayton, men förblir förbryllad över episoden med hennes minnesluckor, som kan komma att inträffa igen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake ger Jeff en tredjedel av ägandet i Denver-Carrington, vilket skjuter upp Adams planer på att få ensam kontroll över företaget.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis misstänker att hennes revisor har samarbetat med Sean för att förstöra Colbyco och måste inse att hon kan förlora sitt imperium. Sammy Jo får reda på Jeffs senaste flört med Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle är omgiven av dem hon älskar och bestämmer sig för att leva. Fallon tar med sig bilden på Blake och den döde mannen till bårhuset, ovetandes om att hon är övervakad.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex tolkar Alexis vendetta mot Blake som ett hat-kärleksförhållande och säger till Alexis att han har fått nog av att bli tagen för given av henne.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle går med på att låta sig opereras, men bara efter att Blake skrivit under hennes skilsmässopapper och livstestamente, som ska verkställas om operationen inte lyckas.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystles operation misslyckas och hon hamnar i koma. Blake, som sörjer, återvänder till Denve och får höra att hon förmodligen aldrig kommer att återhämta sig. Sammy Jo attackeras av en okänd angripare.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake fruktar att hans mörkaste hemlighet kommer att avslöjas på grund av sökandet efter Roger Grimes mördare och lovar att ta på sig skulden för att sätta stopp för utredningen.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.desc: Deep in Fukushima's red zone, explorers discover an untouched high-end tuxedo shop and jewelry store, finding hundreds of abandoned suits worth £500, £1000 each, watches, and gems left behind since the 2011 disaster.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
programme.desc: On July 8, 1980, Andrew and Joyce Manchester returned from vacation to discover their 26-year-old daughter Anne had been missing for 10 days. She vanished without a trace and was never seen again.
programme.sub-title: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named
programme.desc: In November of 1973 female skeletal remains were found in a creek in Colorado. Her identity was restored after 51 years but authorities are still asking the public for help piecing together her story.
programme.sub-title: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy
programme.desc: In June 2006, construction workers in Sutherland, Saskatoon, Canada uncovered the remains of an unidentified woman from the early 1900s. Her name and story remained a mystery for another 19 years.
programme.sub-title: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1999, 27-year-old Michelle Despinasse was shot dead in her Nanuet, NY home. Her answering machine captured her final moments, her voice pleading "Ken, stop", and became key evidence that convicted her ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A beloved teacher is stabbed to death in her own classroom by a 15-year-old student who warned classmates about his plan. No one believed him. A solved true crime case that is shocking, deeply disturbing, and a devastating loss for an entire community.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Teen TRICKED Her Kidnapper and ESCAPED Captivity! The Incredible Survival of Abby Hernandez

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In June 1984, 15-year-old cheerleader Kirsten Costas was lured out and stabbed five times by jealous classmate Bernadette Protti in Orinda, California. The case inspired the TV movie Death of a Cheerleader.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.
programme.sub-title: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.
programme.sub-title: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.
programme.sub-title: Her EVIL Lies Ruined COUNTLESS Lives: The Horrific Crimes of Eleanor Williams

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Suzanne Eaton, a renowned American scientist, vanished while jogging on the Greek island of Crete. The investigation into her murder uncovered a killer hiding in plain sight. A solved true crime case you won't forget.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Devastating Murder of Suzanne Eaton // Murdered While on a Run

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart
